subject: dplyr: Column Classes for Date with Database Backend

messages.author: 03290ff051991093
messages.subject: dplyr: Column Classes for Date with Database Backend
parts:
When I run the following minimal example (for reproducibility), I was hoping to get `Date` at the end, but I do get `numeric`. Based on my understanding, this is because the database backend (in this case SQLite) doesn't have an equivalent of class `Date` in R.

So my question is how to best deal with such cases (and other cases, e.g. POSIX or zoo::yearmon) to ensure consistency between R and the database backend. 

library(dplyr)
iris$date <- Sys.Date() + 1:nrow(iris)
db <- src_sqlite(tempfile(), create = TRUE)
iris2 <- copy_to(db, iris)
collect(select(iris2, date))[[1]]
